title: I Spent 100 Days in RuneScape: Dragonwilds (Fellhollow Update)
author: Rogue
description:
Welcome to Fellhollow, the latest update for RuneScape: Dragonwilds. This new expansion introduces a corrupted forest filled with ancient magic, dangerous creatures, and dark secrets buried deep beneath the roots.

👇 Support the channel!
